items.title: REIGN: Refurbished Embeddings with Integrated Guidance Networks for Efficient Context-Length Scaling
items.title_zh: REIGN：面向高效上下文长度扩展的重构嵌入与集成引导网络
items.summary: REIGN is a contrastively trained bi-encoder that operates on contextualised chunk embeddings from a frozen Guidance Network rather than on raw tokens, targeting multi-chunk document-to-document retrieval and cutting per-document training cost by roughly four orders of magnitude relative to chunked Transformer fine-tuning. It also releases a synthetic long-document retrieval benchmark, matches dense long-context retrievers at smaller parameter budgets on Wikipedia, LoCo and a patent retrieval case study, and stays within 0.65 nDCG@10 of a 20x-larger model on LoCo.

items.title: WeChat team open-sources WeMM-Embedding for multimodal search and recommendation
items.title_zh: 微信团队开源 WeMM-Embedding，用于多模态搜索与推荐
items.summary: Tencent's WeChat Vision team has open-sourced WeMM-Embedding, a family of multimodal embedding models for representing and matching text, images and videos.

items.title: Co-Evolving Structured Knowledge and Reasoning in Language Models
items.title_zh: 语言模型中结构化知识与推理的协同演化
items.summary: KBevo is a co-evolving framework that jointly learns to construct a structured knowledge base and reason over it for knowledge-intensive question answering, optimizing both components end-to-end with QA outcome rewards so that reasoning success directly improves the constructed knowledge base. The authors report larger, better-connected knowledge structures with higher answer reachability, plus improved compositional factual reasoning and controllability compared with standard retrieval baselines.

items.title: Generating Biomedical Fact-Checking Reports with RL-Enhanced Agentic Search
items.title_zh: 用 RL 增强的智能体搜索生成生物医学事实核查报告
items.summary: BioCheck Agent generates structured biomedical fact-checking reports rather than isolated labels, searching only PubMed with Boolean operators and synthesizing conclusions with retrieved evidence. Trained with Evidence-Grounded GRPO, it improves label accuracy on SciFact by 9.95% over its Qwen3.5-4B base, with a 3.7% higher evidence quality score and a 19.63% lower evidence hallucination rate.

items.title: AgentKernel: The Trust-Native Agentic Operating System
items.title_zh: AgentKernel：信任原生的 Agent 操作系统
items.summary: AgentKernel argues that agents need an operating-system substrate with mandatory, non-bypassable services for identity, input mediation, memory governance and execution control, organized into Identity, Perception, Cognition and Execution pillars that adapt classical OS security principles to delegation abuse, prompt injection, memory poisoning and tool misuse. The paper positions it as the missing OS layer beneath orchestration frameworks, agent runtimes, governance platforms and execution sandboxes, supporting the case with systematic comparison and security analysis.

items.title: ADE: Agentic Data Evolution Framework for Human-Centered Objectives
items.title_zh: ADE：面向以人为本目标的智能体数据演化框架
items.summary: ADE is a data-centric framework that organizes synthetic supervision as evolving data snapshots improved through a closed-loop Observation-Variation-Selection procedure, with a steady-state admission mechanism that conservatively gates updates. On DEV300 it raises the intrinsic win rate from 50% to 75.81% and the extrinsic win rate from 55.20% to 68.86%, and blind expert evaluation shows a 66.11% preference for evolved answers.

items.title: Can You Trust Frozen Hematology Foundation Models under Acquisition Shift?
items.title_zh: 采集偏移下冻结血液学基础模型可信吗？
items.summary: The authors audit 15 frozen hematology, pathology and general vision encoders across four public single-cell acquisition domains for accuracy robustness and calibration, finding in-domain macro-F1 saturated at 0.98–0.997 while cross-dataset macro-F1 drops 34–72% and model rankings reorder. Source-trained probes are nearly calibrated in-domain (ECE 0.004) but confidently wrong off-domain (ECE 0.35), and a training-free Class-Balanced Re-standardization improves all target-prior scenario means while leaving residual miscalibration.

items.title: SPECTRA: Subspace-Preserving Embedding Calibration, Transport, and Replay for Fully Few-Shot Class-Incremental Audio Classification
items.title_zh: SPECTRA：面向完全少样本类增量音频分类的子空间保持嵌入校准、迁移与回放
items.summary: SPECTRA is a frozen-encoder framework for fully few-shot class-incremental audio classification that adds a lightweight trainable adapter, exemplar-free subspace feature replay that samples old classes from their stored low-rank subspaces, and transductive optimal-transport prototype refinement at test time. On NSynth-100, FSC-89 and LS-100 it improves average accuracy and reduces forgetting over prior state-of-the-art, with ablations indicating that subspace replay outperforms equal-variance Gaussian replay.

items.title: Assessing mentalization in humans and large language models
items.title_zh: 评估人类与大语言模型的心理化能力
items.summary: The study uses two economic games with cognitive computational modeling to uncover latent mentalization strategies in LLM agents from four model families (DeepSeek, GPT-4.1, GPT-5 and Gemini 2.0 Flash; N = 2,099), benchmarked against 251 human participants. LLMs showed behavioural and computational signatures of mentalizing that differed by provider and size, strategic prompting generally improved performance, and GPT-5 agents adapted their recursive depth of reasoning to opponent sophistication, outperforming human participants.

items.title: Don't Overthink, Don't Underthink: Toward Adaptive Reasoning in Agentic AI
items.title_zh: 别过度思考，也别思考不足：迈向智能体 AI 的自适应推理
items.summary: The paper argues that fixed or pre-allocated reasoning controls suit agentic systems poorly because reasoning demands evolve through planning, tool use, memory retrieval and agent-to-agent interaction, characterizing over-reasoning and under-reasoning as recurring failure modes of misallocated reasoning. On MATH-500 and the GAIA public validation set, over-reasoning cases incur higher computational cost without proportional accuracy gains, while under-reasoning cases are consistently associated with incorrect or incomplete solutions.

items.title: A Versioned Unified Graph Index for Dynamic Timestamp-Aware Nearest Neighbor Search
items.title_zh: 面向动态时间戳感知最近邻搜索的版本化统一图索引
items.summary: TiGER is a time-integrated graph index for approximate nearest neighbor search on dynamic vector datasets that maintains one unified graph with versioned connectivity, so arbitrary time intervals can be queried directly without traversing invalid vectors or post-search filtering. Empirical evaluations report up to 5× improvement in queries per second without compromising accuracy over filtering-based or per-time-segment sub-graph baselines.

items.title: PCFBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Product Carbon Footprint Estimation
items.title_zh: PCFBench：产品碳足迹估算的诊断性基准
items.summary: PCFBench is a diagnostic benchmark that carves product carbon footprint modeling into six independently evaluable tasks requiring decomposition, retrieval, ontology matching and numerical extraction, comprising 614 expert-labelled items. Across eight frontier LLMs from four providers no single model dominates: the strongest models estimate total product emissions within 2× of declared totals on 77% of products, but that rate drops to 37–58% when the PCF is generated step by step, with only 45–75% obeying mass conservation.

items.title: Blind Men and the Elephant: Probing the Epistemic Myopia of LLMs under Long-Tail Divergent Knowledge
items.title_zh: 盲人摸象：探测大模型在长尾分歧知识下的认知短视
items.summary: The paper introduces ElephantBench, a closed-book knowledge probe of 1,094 questions built through an auditable graph-based pipeline that mines naturally occurring disagreements in a low-exposure web corpus and converts them into multi-account QA records verified against source documents and reviewed by human annotators. Across 32 models, even the strongest recovers both accounts on only 52.4% of questions, and scaling model size and inference-time reasoning improve recall but do not eliminate the incompleteness.

items.title: The Halt Vector: Internalizing a Causal Steering Intervention for Efficient Reasoning
items.title_zh: 停止向量：将因果引导干预内化以实现高效推理
items.summary: The authors identify a halt vector at layer 18 of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B whose steering strength controls thinking length, and internalize the intervention into the weights by reconstructing the whole steered activation with off-axis dimensions pinned to their natural values. Fit from 24 problems without reinforcement learning, it removes about a quarter of the thinking at held accuracy across five unseen benchmarks and tracks each problem's own removable slack at 0.70.

items.title: Agents as Knowledge Integrator and Utilizer in Multimodal Recommendation
items.title_zh: Agent 作为多模态推荐中的知识整合者与使用者
items.summary: AgentMMRec is an agent-based multimodal recommendation framework with an Integrator Agent that infers behavior- and multimodal-aware user preferences and item properties into a reusable knowledge memory, and a Utilizer Agent that converts that memory into refined item-item graphs and reranked candidate lists. Experiments on three Amazon datasets show consistent Recall and NDCG gains over recent multimodal baselines, including under sparsity and item cold-start, and the constructed knowledge transfers to existing backbones.

items.title: LiteSearch-VL: Small Multimodal Search Agents via Trajectory Distillation and Synthetic Step-DPO
items.title_zh: LiteSearch-VL：通过轨迹蒸馏与合成逐步 DPO 构建小型多模态搜索 Agent
items.summary: LiteSearch-VL is a low-compute recipe that distills released OpenSearch-VL agent trajectories into Qwen3-VL-2B and 4B backbones using LoRA adapters and synthetic step-level preferences targeting five local failure modes such as premature answers and wrong tools. Across 12,400 GPT-5-judged rollouts, full-trajectory supervised fine-tuning transfers the agent contract and lifts the 2B model from almost never emitting a usable answer to 28.4% macro Pass@1, and a step-budget ablation identifies answer verification rather than search depth as the next bottleneck.

items.title: En-ViMedNER: An English-Vietnamese Parallel Biomedical Corpus with UMLS Semantic Type Annotations
items.title_zh: En-ViMedNER：带 UMLS 语义类型标注的英越平行生物医学语料库
items.summary: En-ViMedNER is described as the first English-Vietnamese parallel biomedical NER corpus annotated with UMLS semantic types, containing 4,392 PubMed abstract pairs, 44,892 sentence pairs and 202,949 aligned entity-mention pairs across 21 semantic types. It is a silver-standard corpus with a human-audited and consensus-corrected mini-test subset, and the best baselines reach F1 52.70 for Vietnamese NER and 45.44 for cross-lingual NER on that subset.

items.title: Token Counts Are Not Model Lineage: A Frozen-Threshold Holdout Study of Black-Box LLM API Fingerprinting
items.title_zh: Token 数不等于模型血统：黑盒 LLM API 指纹识别的冻结阈值留出研究
items.summary: The study tests whether prompt-token counts returned by OpenAI-compatible endpoints can attribute black-box models to families, using 24 labelled endpoint pairs split into development and untouched holdout sets with a frozen threshold. The shift-invariant exact-match score separates all 12 development pairs, but on holdout only 6 pairs are eligible, with balanced accuracy 0.75 and sensitivity 0.50, so token-count consistency is validated as a fingerprint of a shared tokenization stack but rejected as a standalone test of model lineage.

items.title: BenchBench-Protocol: Evaluating Real-World Wet-Lab Protocol Reasoning and Modification
items.title_zh: BenchBench-Protocol：评估真实湿实验室实验方案推理与修改能力
items.summary: The benchmark contains 149 protocol-modification tasks reconstructed from changes scientists made to published wet-lab protocols, drawn from 96 source protocols across nine domains of wet-lab biology. Across nine closed and open models, Claude Opus 5 scores highest at 59.2% normalized rubric score while the others fall between 34.1% and 47.1%, and the benchmark remains unsaturated when taking the best of ten attempts.

items.title: Names Can Hurt: Spotting Slopsquatting Risks Caused by Package Name Hallucinations in Local Coding LLMs
items.title_zh: 名称也能伤人：识别本地编码 LLM 中包名幻觉引发的 slopsquatting 风险
items.summary: The paper proposes a two-layer detector for slopsquatting that combines a deterministic PyPI existence check with a Random Forest classifier over ten package-name and metadata features, bridged by an import-name reconciler and embedded in a LangGraph state machine that retries at escalating temperatures before falling back to another model family. Across 300 curated prompts the pipeline produced hallucination-free code on 76% of runs, and the authors report that hallucination rates scale almost linearly with prompt adversariality, from 0-10% on routine coding to 40-73% on slopsquat baits.

items.title: FLARE: Verifying MILP Reformulations with LLM-Based Theorem Proving
items.title_zh: FLARE：基于 LLM 定理证明的 MILP 重构验证
items.summary: The paper introduces a constructive definition of MILP reformulation that can be formalized and machine-checked in Lean, plus FLARE, an LLM-based agent paired with Lean that verifies proposed reformulations against a reference formulation. On the new FormulationBench (20 problems and 109 formulations) FLARE reports 100% accuracy on the NP-hard subset and produces a machine-checkable certificate for every reformulation it accepts, while a cheaper LLM-only proxy matches its accuracy without certificates.

items.title: Transaction Foundation Models for Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Financial Transaction Data: A Comparative Evaluation with Text Embeddings
items.title_zh: 面向金融交易数据检索增强生成的事务基础模型：与文本嵌入的对比评估
items.summary: The authors build a deterministic 1,026-question QA benchmark with retrieval-level gold-document annotations over IBM's synthetic Anti-Money-Laundering transaction dataset, comparing NVIDIA's 29M-parameter Transaction Foundation Model with five general-purpose and financial text embedding models. The TFM beats every size-matched generic embedder on retrieval (Recall@5 0.81 vs. 0.25–0.39) and end-to-end accuracy (66.7% vs. 27.5%), but a pipeline embedding a hand-engineered aggregated summary with a generic encoder matches or exceeds it overall and dominates on several low-cardinality entity categories.

items.title: Beyond Raw Context Transfer: Representation-based Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: 超越原始上下文传输：基于表征的联邦检索增强生成
items.summary: FedRepRAG is a decentralized RAG framework that keeps raw documents at their owning clients and exchanges only compact latent representations during cross-client retrieval, using a collaboratively trained projector to turn retrieval embeddings into generator-compatible representation tokens for a frozen LLM or VLM backbone. Across decentralized visual QA and QA benchmarks it consistently beats direct-inference and local-retrieval baselines while substantially reducing retrieval-context length and inference overhead compared with raw-context transfer, though residual representation-level leakage remains.

items.title: MoganColBERT-TR: A Late-Interaction Multi-Vector Retrieval Model for Turkish
items.title_zh: MoganColBERT-TR：面向土耳其语的晚期交互多向量检索模型
items.summary: MoganColBERT-TR is a Turkish multi-vector retrieval model that represents queries and documents at the token level through a 768→128 projection and MaxSim late interaction, initialized from the MoganBERT-TR embedding encoder and adapted with single-epoch distillation from a cross-encoder teacher. With 148.9M parameters it scores 37.36 overall (35.53 nDCG@100, 31.81 nDCG@10) across five zero-shot Turkish BEIR datasets, beating the twice-as-large ColmmBERT-base-TR on four of five datasets and finishing second among five compared models.

items.title: NormasTCU --- A Brazilian Portuguese IR Dataset and an Evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge for Relevance Assessment
items.title_zh: NormasTCU：巴西葡萄牙语 IR 数据集与 LLM-as-a-Judge 相关性评估
items.summary: NormasTCU is a Brazilian Portuguese IR dataset with 14,469 legal documents, 46 queries and 3,048 human judgments over 812 query-document pairs, used to evaluate LLM-as-a-judge relevance assessment with three models and two prompt techniques. LLM judges show positive scoring bias (MAE 0.46–0.66 on a 0–2 scale) and only fair-to-moderate agreement with humans (Cohen's kappa 0.32–0.53), but their system rankings for nDCG@10 and MRR often match human rankings (observed Kendall's tau ≥ 0.90, though bootstrap confidence intervals did not always stay above that threshold) while being less reliable for P@10 and R@10.

items.title: Beyond the Answer Key: Robustness Evaluation of Large Language Models for Step-Level Mathematical Verification
items.title_zh: 超越答案键：大语言模型逐步数学验证的鲁棒性评估
items.summary: The paper introduces a controlled linear-equation benchmark that asks LLMs to judge final-answer correctness, step-level trace correctness and the first incorrect step, then tests them on perturbed but logically equivalent solutions. Base models that handle canonical traces degrade sharply on perturbed ones, with false-rejection rates of 75.6–85.3% on valid perturbed traces across GPT-OSS 20B, Qwen3-14B and Phi-4-Reasoning.

items.title: NL2AGBench: Benchmarking LLM Auto-Formalization for AlphaGeometry
items.title_zh: NL2AGBench：评估 LLM 面向 AlphaGeometry 的自动形式化能力
items.summary: NL2AGBench evaluates LLMs on translating English geometry problems into AlphaGeometry-compatible formal representations, using execution-based verification inside AlphaGeometry rather than textual similarity. Across ten open- and closed-source models, leading closed-source models exceed 80% executable translation rates while even the largest open-source models struggle to consistently preserve geometric constraints.

items.title: Hyper3-CLIP: Hierarchy-Conditioned Hyperbolic Vision-Language Training
items.title_zh: Hyper3-CLIP：层级条件化的双曲视觉-语言训练
items.summary: Hyper3-CLIP is a hierarchy-conditioned hyperbolic vision-language model that combines global, local and global-local contrastive learning with query-conditioned visual pooling, training on lightweight query hierarchies built from captions, sentence fragments, part descriptions and extracted phrases. Query-conditioned pooling is active only during training, and the model improves R@5 and R@10 retrieval on COCO and Flickr plus multi-label classification on VOC and COCO while remaining competitive on hierarchy metrics.

items.title: "Act Like a 5th Grader" is Not Enough: Bounding Knowledge in LLM-Based User Simulators
items.title_zh: “表现得像五年级学生”还不够：限定 LLM 用户模拟器的知识边界
items.summary: Using over 71,000 reading-comprehension responses from 2,359 primary-school students in grades 4 to 6, the authors show that standard persona prompting makes LLM user simulators near-perfect and deterministic, missing the natural variance of developing readers. They introduce the Cognitively Bounded User Simulator, an architectural framework that models restricted working memory through an episodic bottleneck and two test-taking strategies, narrowing the simulation gap across multiple backbones.

items.title: Perceive to Hypothesize, Verify to Ground: An Agentic Reasoning Framework for Open-World Geo-Localization
items.title_zh: 先感知再假设，再验证以落地：开放世界地理定位的 Agent 推理框架
items.summary: GeoPAVE reformulates open-world geo-localization as a perceive-then-verify reasoning problem, using a bi-level agentic framework that generates hypotheses from single-pass rollouts and grounds decisions through support, refute and refine verification actions. The authors also introduce PAVED, a dataset derived from real-world user check-in data with multi-hop queries, multi-round tool invocations and structured perception-verification traces.

items.title: typesafe-ai/skills
items.title_zh: typesafe-ai/skills：基于 TypeSafe System One API 的 Agent 技能集
items.summary: The repository collects agent skills aimed at developers building on TypeSafe's System One API.

items.title: Tencent/WeMM-Embedding
items.title_zh: Tencent/WeMM-Embedding：微信视觉团队的多模态嵌入模型
items.summary: WeMM-Embedding is a family of universal multimodal embedding models from Tencent's WeChat Vision Team, supporting multimodal understanding and retrieval; the repository is written in Python.

items.title: brayonpi/hexstellar
items.title_zh: brayonpi/hexstellar：把 AI Agent 变成计算研究员
items.summary: HexStellar Cortex turns an AI agent into a computational researcher, offering software-accelerated optimization, quantum computing, scientific computing, decision intelligence and verifiable execution through a Python CLI and API. It includes certainty labels, verification receipts, examples and a free sandbox, and can be installed with pip.

items.title: sharptoolbox/ontology-driven-dev
items.title_zh: sharptoolbox/ontology-driven-dev：本体驱动业务系统开发技能
items.summary: The repository packages an ontology-driven development skill that moves from requirement discovery through ontology modeling to application building, built on a seven-model ontology YAML and a code-PaaS base, and supporting WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex.

items.title: Hy4 preview
items.title_zh: 腾讯发布 Hy4 预览版
items.summary: Tencent released and open-sourced Hy4 preview, a large language model with 770B total parameters, 49B active parameters and a context window exceeding 1M tokens.

items.title: Arkios: An Open Bilingual English-Nepali Language Model Trained From Scratch, with a Devanagari-Aware Tokenizer
items.title_zh: Arkios：从零训练的开源英尼双语语言模型与天城文感知分词器
items.summary: Arkios is a 1.04B-parameter dense transformer pretrained from scratch on 150B tokens of bilingual English-Nepali text with a custom single-file C/CUDA training stack and a Devanagari-aware byte-level BPE tokenizer. The authors report that the standard multiple-choice-letter prompt format places the model at chance in both Nepali and English while scoring answer text directly reveals genuine English-favoring comprehension, and they release base and instruction-tuned weights under Apache-2.0.

items.title: WeChat team open-sources WeMM-Embedding for multimodal search and recommendation
items.title_zh: 微信团队开源 WeMM-Embedding，用于多模态搜索与推荐
items.summary: Tencent's WeChat Vision team has open-sourced WeMM-Embedding, a family of multimodal embedding models for representing and matching text, images and videos.

items.title: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead
items.title_zh: Hugging Face 事件及其后续之路
items.summary: OpenAI shares findings from the Hugging Face security incident and outlines steps it is taking to strengthen AI model security, monitoring and alignment.

items.title: Piloting the world's first double-blind AI evaluations
items.title_zh: 试点全球首个双盲 AI 评估
items.summary: Google DeepMind announced a pilot of what it describes as the world's first double-blind AI evaluations.

items.title: Baidu launches DuMateBench benchmark for real-world AI agent delivery
items.title_zh: 百度推出 DuMateBench，衡量 AI Agent 的真实任务交付能力
items.summary: Baidu launched DuMateBench, an evaluation leaderboard designed to measure whether AI agents can complete real-world tasks and deliver usable outputs.

items.title: I accidentally turned LLM memory into program analysis
items.title_zh: 我阴差阳错地把 LLM 记忆做成了程序分析
items.summary: The author explains why he stopped trying to give LLM agents a better memory and instead built Lemmalog, a Datalog engine that keeps an agent's knowledge as analysis state with provenance, retractions and incremental evaluation, reporting benchmark results on LongMemEval and LoCoMo.
